titleEn: Surrey Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real Prices From $25,000
titleZh: 素里厨房装修费用2026：真实价格从$25,000起
contentEn:
Surrey homeowners spend between $25,000 and $38,000 on a kitchen renovation in 2026, with most projects in the $28,000–$31,000 range. Cabinet scope, countertop material, and whether plumbing or electrical work is needed drive the final cost.

What Determines Your Surrey Kitchen Renovation Cost

Cabinetry is the largest single line item — stock cabinets $150–$300/linear ft, custom $400–$800/linear ft. Countertops — laminate ($20–$40/sq ft) versus quartz ($60–$120/sq ft) can add $3,000–$6,000. Layout changes that move plumbing or gas lines add $2,000–$5,000 per fixture.

Surrey Kitchen Renovation Project Prices

All prices include materials, labour, and GST.

ScopeBudgetDuration
Stock cabinets, laminate counters, no layout change$25,000–$30,0004–5 weeks
Custom cabinets, quartz counters, same layout$29,000–$31,0004–5 weeks
Full custom cabinets, quartz, appliance upgrades$35,000–$38,0004–5 weeks

Permits and Strata Requirements in Surrey

Surrey follows BC Building Code 9.36. Moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural elements, or projects over $5,000 require a building permit. Cosmetic work within existing layout — cabinet replacement, countertop swapping, flooring — typically does not. Strata properties require separate design approval before work begins, which can take 4–8 weeks.

How Long Does a Surrey Kitchen Renovation Take?

Based on three completed Surrey kitchen projects, the timeline is consistently 4–5 weeks from demolition to final inspection. Layout changes that move the sink or stove add 1–2 weeks for plumbing and electrical permits.

2026 Surrey Kitchen Trends

Surrey homeowners in 2026 favour clean contemporary aesthetics: white or light grey flat-panel (shaker) cabinets, white or marble-look quartz countertops, and matte black or brushed nickel hardware. Open-concept layouts that remove peninsulas or partial walls are popular but require an engineer's letter and a Surrey building permit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Average cost in 2026?

$28,000–$31,000 for a mid-range kitchen with custom cabinets and quartz countertops. Budget projects start around $25,000; high-end full custom up to $38,000. All prices include materials, labour, and GST.

Permit required?

Moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural walls, or projects over $5,000 require a Surrey building permit. Cosmetic work within the existing layout does not. Contact Surrey building department with questions.

How long?

4–5 weeks for standard Surrey kitchen renovation with no layout change. Layout changes add 1–2 weeks for permit processing.

Strata approval needed?

Yes for strata properties. Separate from the Surrey building permit, strata approval can take 4–8 weeks. Reno Stars coordinates both the permit application and strata approval process.
contentZh:
2026年，素里房主的厨房装修费用通常在25,000至38,000加元之间，大多数项目集中在28,000至31,000加元。橱柜规模、台面材料、是否需要管道或电气工程决定最终费用。

影响素里厨房装修费用的因素

橱柜是最大的单项支出——成品橱柜每线性英尺150至300加元，定制橱柜每线性英尺400至800加元。台面——层压板与人造石英石的差异可使总费用增加3,000至6,000加元。布局变更（需移动管道或煤气管道）每个固定装置增加2,000至5,000加元。

素里厨房装修项目价格

所有价格均含材料、人工和GST。

范围预算工期
成品橱柜、层压板台面、无布局变更25,000–30,000加元4–5周
定制橱柜、石英石台面、相同布局29,000–31,000加元4–5周
全定制橱柜、石英石台面、设备升级35,000–38,000加元4–5周

素里许可证和分契物业要求

素里遵循BC省建筑规范9.36。移动管道装置、改变结构构件或项目价值超过5,000加元需要建筑许可证。现有布局内的装修工程通常不需要。分契物业需在工程开始前获得独立的设计批准，可能需4至8周。

素里厨房装修需要多长时间？

根据三个已完成的素里厨房项目，时间表始终为4至5周。移动水槽或炉灶位置需额外1至2周管道和电气许可证处理时间。

2026年素里厨房趋势

2026年素里房主偏好简洁当代美学：白色或浅灰色平面橱柜、白色或大理石纹石英石台面、哑光黑色或拉丝镍五金。开放式概念布局（拆除半岛或部分墙壁）受欢迎，但需要结构工程师函和素里市许可证。

常见问题

2026年平均费用？

中档厨房（定制橱柜加石英石台面）28,000至31,000加元。预算项目约25,000加元起；高端全定制装修可达38,000加元。所有价格含材料、人工和GST。

需要许可证？

移动管道装置、改变结构墙或项目超过5,000加元需要素里建筑许可证。现有布局内的装修工程不需要。有疑问请联系素里市建设部门。

需要多长时间？

无布局变更的标准素里厨房装修需4至5周。布局变更项目另加1至2周许可证处理时间。

分契物业需要批准？

是的。分契物业的装修设计批准与素里市建筑许可证分开流程，可能需4至8周。聚星装修代办许可证申请和分契批准协调整个流程。
